symptom: A navigation or menu-document menu item calling a microflow/nanoflow with a parameter, or showing a page with a required parameter, passed check -p and exec; mx check 11.14.0 then reported CE1571 "No argument has been selected for parameter 'Thing' and no default is available" at Menu item
cause: The CE1571 rule (validateFlowArguments/argDiff) only walked widget trees; menu items are not widgets, so no menu statement ever reached argDiff
insight: A rule keyed on a construct's CONTAINER (widgets) misses every other container of the same call: grep for every AST that holds an ActionV3 (menu items, alter navigation set/insert fragments via menuAlterView) when a CE is 'any call whose parameters are not filled'. A menu item is argDiff in an EMPTY dataContext. Measured 11.14.0, one project per variant: object/String flow params, required object/String page params, menu document and alter-navigation insert -> 6 CE1571 (one per item); parameterless flow/page, an optional page parameter (11.5+) and a literal argument `(Text = 'hello')` -> 0 errors, so an optional page parameter and any stated argument are not reported. `create object E then show page P` passes the new object, so only the item's own action is judged; an unresolved target stays silent (validateNavigationTargets owns not-found). Script-declared pages needed their whole ast.PageParameter (Optional) recorded — sc.pageParamNames keeps names only.
